characters.notes: Racing horse owned by Jon Thane, sold to Lan. Rand ends up riding him.
Mentioned as believing Moiraine and agreeing that Rand had to go.
Leading a patrol; wears old armor. Formerly owned the horse Cloud, sold to Lan. Known for racing Cloud against merchants' horses and never losing.
Made Perrin's axe two years ago for a wool-buyer's guard who then refused to pay. Gave it to Perrin.
Digging through the ruins of her house, hoping the Trollocs come back so she can get her hands on them.
Rand asked him questions without revealing the reason for leaving.

appearances.whereabouts: In the stable at the Winespring Inn, then leading the party out of Emond's Field toward the North Road
appearances.notable_actions: Checks the horses and gear. Questions Perrin about whether he checked for watchers. Instructs the group on weapons and danger. Leads them stealthily through Emond's Field, avoiding patrols. Reacts to the Draghkar sighting and orders the group to the North Road.
appearances.demeanor: Alert, vigilant, professional, terse, commanding. Shows brief fury when Moiraine allows Egwene to come, but accepts her judgment.

appearances.whereabouts: In the stable, then riding with the group leaving Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: Reports that he checked for watchers as Lan instructed. Reveals his axe when questioned. Explains how he got it from Master Luhhan. Admits he didn't think to check the hayloft. Reacts with alarm to mention of wolves.
appearances.demeanor: Defensive, earnest, somewhat embarrassed when his axe is revealed and when he failed to check the hayloft

appearances.whereabouts: In the stable, then riding with the group leaving Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: Teases Rand about the sword and Perrin about the axe. Left a note for his family. Defends the decision not to tell anyone in person.
appearances.demeanor: Joking to deflect tension, but underlying fear about Aes Sedai and Tar Valon; nervous laughter

appearances.whereabouts: In the stable, then riding with the group leaving Emond's Field on Cloud
appearances.notable_actions: Wears the sword given by Tam. Reveals he told his father about leaving. Suggests Bela for Egwene. Saddles Bela. Tries to dissuade Egwene from coming. Spots the Draghkar flying across the moon and reports it.
appearances.demeanor: Protective of Egwene, homesick even before leaving, earnest, somewhat defensive about telling his father

appearances.whereabouts: At the stable in the Winespring Inn, then leading the party (with Lan) out of Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: Questions Rand about telling his father. Allows Egwene to join despite Lan's objections. Approves Thom's joining. Gives the order to move quickly. Identifies the Draghkar and explains the urgency of reaching Taren Ferry. Gives Thom a sharp look when he speaks of the Age of Legends.
appearances.demeanor: Calm, authoritative, decisive, speaks of the Pattern with certainty

appearances.whereabouts: Arrives at the stable, then rides Bela with the group leaving Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: Slips into the stable with her bundle. Insists on joining the journey despite objections. Explains how she deduced the plan. Dismisses Rand's warnings about Trollocs as nonsense. Mounts Bela and reassures Rand.
appearances.demeanor: Defiant, determined, eager to see the world, tolerant and patient with Rand's protectiveness

appearances.whereabouts: In the hayloft, then riding with the group leaving Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: Reveals himself from the hayloft. Insists on traveling to Tar Valon. Explains he has no use staying in Emond's Field. Speaks of the Draghkar and the Age of Legends.
appearances.demeanor: Wry, resourceful, determined to survive, slightly defensive under Lan's scrutiny

appearances.whereabouts: In her stall in the stable, then carrying Egwene out of Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: Saddled by Rand. Accepts the saddle with only a shake of her mane despite not being used to one.

appearances.whereabouts: In the stable, then carrying Rand out of Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: Prances and tosses head when Rand tries to mount. Described as eager to run.

appearances.whereabouts: Leading a patrol near the Winespring Inn
appearances.notable_actions: Leads a dozen men on patrol. Peers into the common-room window. Marches the patrol into the night.

relationships.description: Moiraine is the Aes Sedai who holds the Warder bond; Lan is her Warder. He defers to her judgment even when he disagrees.
Rand is protective of Egwene and promises to look after her. She smooths his hair affectionately and says they will look after each other.

Tam is Rand's father; Rand told him about the journey and Tam agreed he had to go
